propositions: The DC transport is missing twelve methods required by the reconciler (set_entity_property, delete_issue, delete_issue_link, get_comments, get_issue_by_rest, get_issue_links, get_parent_map, remove_label, set_issue_property, set_parent, set_reporter, validate_assignee_exists), causing a crash when the writing path reaches set_entity_property.

Seven of the twelve missing methods have call sites that swallow exceptions at every invocation, producing silent degradation where the reconciler appears to converge while quietly failing to sync comments, links, properties, and validations.

The TicketTransport protocol declares only six members while the core requires twenty-one distinct transport members across all paths, and lacks @runtime_checkable, so isinstance conformance cannot be enforced at construction time.

Reporter sync perpetually re-emits mutations on DC because inbound_fields._identity_of reads only accountId and yields None for DC reporters, causing _diff_reporter to emit changed[reporter] on every pass even after a successful write.

Each of the twelve absent members requires a recorded triage decision (implement with DC v2 semantics, raise NotImplementedError naming the limitation, or document as unreachable by call site) rather than a blanket translation from Cloud's implementation.
